title: Keep a window reference
summary: The main process can keep a reference to its window and clear it when the window is closed.
introduction: The main process can keep a reference to its window and clear it when the window is closed. Your task: Identify when the reference is cleared.
learningObjectives: Identify when the reference is cleared.
Explain the example for keep a window reference

blocks.text: The main process can keep a reference to its window and clear it when the window is closed. This helps manage the app lifecycle.

Use a local Electron project with electron installed as a dev dependency and main.cjs as its main file. Run with npx electron . after creating package.json and index.html. These APIs do not run in a web-page playground.
